subject: Financial Aid Application Submitted
body:
Dear $student_name,

Your financial aid application has been submitted successfully.

APPLICATION DETAILS:
================================================================================
Academic Year: $academic_year
Submission Date: $submission_date
Application Status: Pending Review
================================================================================

Your application is now under review by our financial aid team. You will be notified once a decision has been made.

Please ensure all required documentation has been submitted. You can check your application status through the student portal.

If you have any questions, please contact the Financial Aid Office.

Thank you,
University Financial Aid Office

variables.academic_year: Academic year for the aid application
variables.submission_date: Date when the application was submitted
